title: The structure of deception: Validation of the lying profile questionnaire
authors: Makowski, D., Pham, T., Lau, Z. J., Raine, A., & Chen, S. H. A.
summary: Lying is usually studied as something to be detected. This paper turns it around and measures it as a disposition, validating the Lying Profile Questionnaire — how much, how well and why a person lies — as a way of describing the structure of everyday deception.
